user.title: PS5LM
user.description: Starts and stops PS5LM on a jailbroken PS5 on demand. The console needs ps5-payload-websrv running and Remote Play registration (the keys chiaki-ng stores as rp_regist_key and rp_key).

data.host: PS5 host name or IP address
data.morning: Remote Play morning key (32 hex characters)

settings.title: PS5LM settings
settings.description: Defaults are filled in; change them only if your setup differs.

data.title_id: PS5LM title ID (PPSA99575 official, PPSA99581 Plus)
data.api_url: PS5LM API URL (health, metrics and model info are read from here)
data.llm_metrics: Read model server metrics (speed, requests, tokens)
data.console_metrics: Read console metrics (temperatures, fan, memory, storage)
data.console_interval: Console metrics interval (each read stalls the model for a few seconds, so keep it rare)

error.cannot_connect: The console did not answer on the discovery port. It must be in rest mode or on.
error.invalid_credentials: The regist key must be hex (up to 16 characters) and the morning key 32 hex characters.
